draft.body: This page is a working draft written by the site operator. It is not legal advice and has not been reviewed by a lawyer. It will be reviewed by a qualified professional before the site is promoted publicly, and it may change.

dataSources.title: Data sources and credits
dataSources.intro: SoK Game Calendar is a release calendar and database for video games. This page lists where the information comes from and who owns the material shown on the site.

igdb.title: IGDB
igdb.body:
Game, platform, release date and event data comes from IGDB.com. We retrieve it through the IGDB API on a regular schedule and store a copy in our own database.
The credit "Data from IGDB.com" is shown in the footer of every page and links to https://www.igdb.com/. IGDB's own terms apply to its data.

covers.title: Cover art and trademarks
covers.body:
Cover images, logos, game titles and platform names belong to their respective publishers, developers and platform holders. Cover images are loaded from IGDB's image servers and are shown only to identify the games on this site.
This site is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any publisher, developer or platform holder.

manual.title: Manual corrections
manual.body: Some release dates and details are corrected by the site operator, often after a report from a visitor. Entries that were confirmed by hand are marked as such in the data, and when they disagree with IGDB the manually confirmed entry is shown first.

ratings.title: Scores
ratings.body: Where scores are shown, the name of the source is shown next to each score. A score is an opinion of its source, not of this site.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.body: Release dates are announced, delayed and cancelled often. The information on this site can be wrong, incomplete or out of date. Please confirm with the publisher or the store before you rely on it, for example before you make a purchase.

corrections.title: Corrections and removal requests
corrections.body: If you find a mistake, use the report link on the game, platform or event page. If you hold rights to material shown here and want it removed, see the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information the site handles when you use it. The site has no ads and no analytics. Accounts are optional: every public feature works without signing in.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body:
We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
We set only two kinds of cookies:
- sok_locale: set only when you pick a language from the language menu. It holds just the language code and is kept for up to a year, so the site opens in that language next time.
- Sign-in cookies (names starting with better-auth): set only when you sign in to an account, to recognize your signed-in state. A sign-in lasts up to 30 days and the cookies are cleared when you sign out or delete your account.
You can delete these cookies in your browser at any time; the public features keep working without the sign-in cookies.

storage.title: Data stored in your browser
storage.body: If you choose which rating sources to show on a game page, your choice is saved in your browser's local storage on your own device. It is not sent to our server.

logs.title: Server and network logs
logs.body: To deliver pages and protect the site against abuse, the servers and the content delivery network in front of them (Cloudflare) process technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the address you requested. We keep access logs only as long as needed for security and troubleshooting.

reports.title: Data correction reports
reports.body:
If you send a report we store what you submitted (the type of report, the item concerned, the proposed value, the source link and the note), the time of the report, and a keyed hash of your IP address that is used to limit abuse. The hash is erased after 90 days. We do not ask for your name or email address; please do not enter personal information in the form.
Takedown requests are not shown publicly and are sent to the site owner only.
The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to tell people from bots. Turnstile is operated by Cloudflare and processes technical information about your browser under Cloudflare's own privacy policy.

feeds.title: Calendar feeds
feeds.body: The public calendar feeds (.ics) need no sign-in. We do not identify who subscribes; your calendar application requests the feed address from our server and the request appears in the server logs described above.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body:
You may choose to create an account (with email and password, or by signing in with Discord, Google, Twitch, X, Microsoft or Steam). Once you have an account, we handle the following data:
- Account data: display name, email address (if your sign-in method provides one), avatar URL, the sign-in methods you link and your identifier at each service, and your password stored only as a hash (never in plain text).
- Sign-in state: the IP address and browser information from when you signed in, used to recognize and protect your sign-in.
- Authorization credentials from other services: if you use social sign-in, we store the credentials that service gives us, encrypted, and use them only for features you ask for.
- Content you create: lists, play records (including reviews and private notes), follows, and your preferences.
- Game library: if you link Steam and import, we store the game IDs and titles in your library and how they were matched to games on this site.
- Private calendar: we generate a personal subscription URL for you (treat it like a password and do not share it) and record when it was last read.
This data is used to provide the account features (sign-in, collections, follows, private calendar, library matching). It is not used for advertising and is not sold.

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: The database is backed up every day to storage outside the server, encrypted. Backups are kept for 7 days (daily), 4 weeks (weekly) and 6 months (monthly), and these periods may be adjusted. Information removed from the live database can remain in backups until they expire.

thirdParties.title: Other services
thirdParties.body: Game data and cover images come from IGDB (see the data sources page). Pages are delivered through Cloudflare. Links to other sites lead to services we do not control, and their own privacy policies apply.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this page. The date of the latest revision is shown at the top.

accountVisibility.title: Public and private content
accountVisibility.body: By default only you can see your data. You choose the visibility of lists and reviews (public, unlisted but visible to anyone with the link, or private); private notes and your follow list are never public. Public lists and reviews show your display name. Only aggregated numbers are shown publicly (for example follower counts or the player average rating), never who is behind them. An administrator may suspend an account for abuse; a suspended account can still access and export its own data.

accountRetention.title: Retention, export and deletion
accountRetention.body:
We keep the data above while you have an account. At any time, on your account's "Privacy and data" page, you can:
- Export your data (JSON, or CSV in parts).
- Delete your account: the account and its lists, play records (including public reviews and private notes), follows, game library and private calendar settings are permanently deleted, your private calendar URL stops working immediately, and this cannot be undone. Deleting requires re-verifying your identity (entering your password, or having just signed in again).
After deletion, aggregated anonymous statistics (such as the player average rating) stop including your data at the next recalculation. Database backups may still contain deleted data during their retention period (see "Backups" below: 8 days for daily, 29 days for weekly, about 190 days at most for monthly) and then expire on their own; backups are not used to run the site.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using this site you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

scope.title: What the site is
scope.body: SoK Game Calendar provides information about video game release dates and related events. It is free to use and offered for personal, non-commercial information.

accuracy.title: No guarantee of accuracy
accuracy.body: The information is provided "as is". Release dates and other details can be wrong, incomplete or out of date, and we do not guarantee otherwise. Check with the publisher or the store before you rely on it.

ip.title: Ownership of material
ip.body: Game titles, cover art, logos and platform names belong to their respective owners (see the data sources page). Data from IGDB is subject to IGDB's terms. Using the site does not give you any rights in third-party material.

use.title: Acceptable use

reports.title: Reports you submit
reports.body: When you send a report you confirm that the content is yours to share and is not unlawful. We may accept, change or reject any report at our discretion.

links.title: External links
links.body: Links to other sites are provided for convenience. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for them.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: We may change, suspend or stop any part of the site at any time without notice.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for any loss arising from the use of, or inability to use, the site or from reliance on its information.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. The date of the latest revision is shown at the top. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.

contact.title: Contact and takedown requests
contact.intro: At the moment the site has no public email address. Requests are handled through the report form.

general.title: Questions and corrections
general.body: To report wrong or missing information, open the page of the game, platform or event and use its "Report a problem" link. For anything else, choose the report type "Something else" in the same form.

takedown.title: Takedown and copyright requests

privacy.title: Privacy questions
privacy.body: Questions about how information is handled are covered by the privacy policy. Because reports are anonymous, we may not be able to find a particular report from the IP address alone.
